chunks: Abu 'Ali Muhammad ibn al-Junayd, the scribe, al-Iskafi.

key_terms.أَبُو: A kunyah component meaning 'father of,' used as an honorific identifier.
key_terms.الْإِسْكَافِيُّ: A nisbah indicating attribution to al-Iskaf.
key_terms.الْجُنَيْدِ: His family name or lineage designation: ibn al-Junayd.
key_terms.الْكَاتِبُ: A professional or descriptive epithet meaning 'the scribe.'
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: The second part of the kunyah, completing the name Abu 'Ali.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ: The personal name of the individual identified in the entry.

ai.seo_question: Who is Abu 'Ali Muhammad ibn al-Junayd al-Katib al-Iskafi in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This text is a brief biographical naming of a scholar: Abu 'Ali Muhammad ibn al-Junayd al-Katib al-Iskafi. It serves as an identification entry among shaykhs rather than a hadith text with sanad or matn.
